background-color: #ff5a00; } .switch { --switch-bg: #ff5a00; } Jobs > Level Artist Level Artist Indefinite Full time Hybrid (Lisbon, Lisbon, Portugal) Summary: Studio Ellipsis is seeking a visionary Level Artist to help shape the visual identity of our new IP, a PC-first cross-platform PvEvP game. This project features a strong and iconic art direction set within a world steeped in deep and rich lore. As a Leve
items.requirements: l Artist, you will play a crucial role in crafting immersive environments that not only captivate players visually but also enhance the overall gameplay and world-building experience. If you are passionate about creating iconic visuals in a lore-rich universe, we want to hear from you. Responsibilities: ● Environment Creation: Design, model, and texture high-quality 3D environments, ensuring they align with the game’s artistic vision and technical constraints. ● Collaboration: Work closely with level designers to integrate art assets seamlessly into gameplay, ensuring that visuals and mechanics complement each other. ● Visual Storytelling: Incorporate story elements and environmental cues into level design to create rich, immersive worlds. ● Optimization: Optimize assets and environments for performance across multiple platforms, ensuring a smooth and consistent player experience. ● Iteration: Respond to feedback from playtesting and team reviews, refining environments to enhance visual appeal and gameplay flow. ● Documentation: Create and maintain documentation for level art pipelines, including asset lists, reference materials, and best practices. ● Trend Awareness: Stay informed on industry trends, new tools, and techniques in level art, particularly in PvEvP and cross-platform development. Requirements: ● Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Game Art, 3D Art, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. ● Professional Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in level art or environment art, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work on shipped titles. Technical Skills: ● Proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Unreal Engine, Unity, Maya, 3ds Max, and Substance Painter/Designer ● Artistic Skills: Strong understanding of color theory, lighting, composition, and visual storytelling in 3D environments. ● Optimization Skills: Experience optimizing assets for performance across various platforms, particularly in large, open-world environments. ● Communication Skills: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including designers, programmers, and narrative writers. ● Problem-Solving Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, creativity, and attention to detail. ● Passion for Gaming: A deep love for gaming, particularly in PvEvP and cross-platform genres, with an understanding of current market trends. Indefinite Full time Hybrid (Lisbon, Lisbon, Portugal)
